rules.rule: izinkan HANYA jika contractType=='PERPETUAL' AND quoteAsset=='USDT' AND status=='TRADING' AND underlyingType=='COIN'; selain itu default DENY (termasuk listing baru dengan tipe yang belum dikenal)
contractType=='TRADIFI_PERPETUAL' -> blacklist (saham, ETF, komoditas, forex, pre-IPO)
'TradFi' in underlyingSubType -> blacklist (jaring pengaman bila Binance memakai contractType PERPETUAL)
underlyingType not in {'COIN'} -> blacklist (default deny tipe baru: EQUITY, HK_EQUITY, KR_EQUITY, CN_EQUITY, COMMODITY, FX, dll)
baseAsset in COMMODITY_TOKENS -> blacklist (token yang melacak harga komoditas walau underlyingType=COIN)
baseAsset in STABLECOINS -> blacklist (pegged, tidak ada volatilitas scalping)
re-evaluasi saat start + tiap 1 jam dari /fapi/v1/exchangeInfo; symbol yang hilang/status!=TRADING otomatis keluar dari universe; hasil berubah -> log + alert

rwa_review_allowed.note: RWA-tag tapi token protokol crypto-native; diizinkan, review manual
